# Dauntless Revived

> Dauntless Revived is a private, non-commercial server revival of Dauntless, the Phoenix Labs co-op monster-hunting game whose official servers shut down on 30 May 2025. It runs the genuine Dauntless 1.4.4 client (October 2020, Unreal Engine 4) against a self-hosted fork of the open-source Undaunted server by gwog and contributors (AGPL-3.0).

- It is not a public server. It is run for a few friends, and anyone with their own copy of the 1.4.4 client can host the same thing from the source code (https://github.com/mixutin/dauntless-revived).
- Status as of 22 September 2026: the owner played it first on the host PC and then over the internet on a rented server, from the invite and the game download to the first hunt. For the owner, login with a personal account key (no Epic account needed), the tutorial, Ramsgate, the Training Dojo, hunts and crafting work. Items, gear and quests are saved and backed up hourly. Slayer level, mastery and the Hunt Pass (with the Elite pass for every account) are saved too: real progression is on by default and passed an in-game test on a throwaway account. Later that night two players saw each other in Ramsgate and hunted together over the internet, after queueing the same hunt. Parties, the friends list and guilds are built on the server side; in that test a party invite and a friend request did not show in game, and the fixes (running on the server, not yet tried in game) wait for the next two-player test. Not yet working: text chat, online status and bounties. The home page and the roadmap have the current state.
- No game files are distributed by the site or the repository. Every player needs their own copy of the client.
- Not affiliated with, endorsed by or supported by Phoenix Labs or Epic Games. "Dauntless" is a trademark of its owners.
- Built on Undaunted (https://github.com/SyST3MDeV/Undaunted) by gwog (Gregory Morford) and contributors: the server-mode DLL, the deploy server, the metagame backend and the launcher are theirs.

## Start here

- [Home](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/): Dauntless Revived is a private server revival of Dauntless: the genuine 1.4.4 client on a self-hosted fork of Undaunted. What works and how to set it up.
- [FAQ](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/faq.html): Can you still play Dauntless? Is there a private server? Short answers about Dauntless Revived: versions, Epic accounts, joining, hosting, legality and Linux.

## Setup

- [Setup](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/): How to run Dauntless Revived on Windows, Linux or OpenBSD, let invited friends join, run it for a group, and fix common problems.
- [Host a server](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/host.html): Step-by-step guide to hosting a Dauntless 1.4.4 private server on one Windows PC: verify the build, place the two DLLs, set up the metagame and deploy server.
- [Hosting partner](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/hosting-partner.html): EU Gamehost partnership and recommended hosting examples for Dauntless Revived.
- [Join as a friend](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/friends.html): How an invited friend joins a Dauntless Revived server: Tailscale, a hash-checked Dauntless 1.4.4 install, the two DLLs, an invite code and the friend kit.
- [Linux launcher](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/linux.html): Install and run Dauntless Revived on Linux: Ubuntu, Debian, Mint, Pop!_OS, Fedora, openSUSE, Arch, EndeavourOS, CachyOS, Manjaro, NixOS, Gentoo, Void and other x86_64 distributions.
- [Run it for a group](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/admin.html): Opening a Dauntless Revived server to a few friends: Tailscale sharing, firewall rules, invite codes, admin accounts, capacity figures and database backups.
- [Steam Deck](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/steam-deck.html): Install the native Dauntless Revived Linux launcher on Steam Deck, enable the balanced 800p preset, and troubleshoot Proton cutscenes.
- [Troubleshooting](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/troubleshooting.html): Problems we hit running the Dauntless 1.4.4 client against a Dauntless Revived server, with causes and fixes: port clashes, login, blurry graphics, Defender and git.
- [Windows server kit](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/windows-server.html): Install a Dauntless Revived server on a rented Windows Server 2019 VPS in public mode: one TLS gateway port with a pinned certificate, game ports opened only for logged-in players, key-only SSH deployment, invites, updates and backups.
- [Linux server](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/linux-server.html): Run the Dauntless Revived server stack on x86_64 Linux: native Node services, Proton/Wine game servers, systemd and nftables.
- [OpenBSD server](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/openbsd-server.html): Run the Dauntless Revived control plane natively on OpenBSD 7.9 with PF and rc.d, using a separate Linux Proton/Wine game worker.
- [Upgrade notes](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/setup/upgrading.html): What changes for players when you update an existing Dauntless Revived server: the port of Harmonic's fork (Slayer Links on; Escalation, the store and online status built but off), text chat, friends, parties and guilds, and real progression on by default. How to keep old max ranks, start fresh, or stay on the stub.

## Reference

- [Reference](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/reference/): Reference for Dauntless Revived: every setting, port, HTTP route, file, game setting and script, with defaults and who sets them, checked against the code.
- [Configuration](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/reference/configuration.html): Every environment variable of the Dauntless Revived servers: defaults, allowed values, what each does, who sets it, and which switches are on by default.
- [Ports and network](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/reference/ports.html): Every TCP and UDP port of a Dauntless Revived server: who listens where, bind addresses in private and public mode, request paths and the kit firewall rules.
- [HTTP API](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/reference/api.html): Every HTTP route of the Dauntless Revived metagame, deploy server, content server and gateway, with who may call it and what the internet can reach.
- [Files and data](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/reference/files.html): Where Dauntless Revived keeps its files: the repository, a host's folders, the server kit's install root, the SQLite database, logs, backups and the launcher.
- [Game settings](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/reference/game-settings.html): What Dauntless Revived changes in the 1.4.4 client and its game servers: the user ini files and who writes them, command lines, the two DLLs, the pinned build, and the game data the metagame serves.
- [Scripts and parameters](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/reference/scripts.html): Every script you run for Dauntless Revived: the Windows server kit, the friend kit, tools/ and the npm scripts, with each parameter, its default and examples.
- [Developer guide](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/reference/development.html): How to work on Dauntless Revived: prerequisites, building and testing each package, running the stack and the launcher locally, CI, and where the code lives.

## Findings

- [Findings](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/): What we learned about how the online side of Dauntless worked, from the 1.4.4 and 2.1.1 clients: backend contract, client internals, multiplayer and crashes.
- [Verifying game files](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/verification.html): How we checked that community-shared Dauntless builds are genuine, complete and clean: Authenticode signatures, Phoenix Labs' install manifest and ClamAV.
- [Game assets and config](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/assets.html): How the Dauntless 1.4.4 and 2.1.1 builds store content: pak v9 and IoStore containers, Oodle, the cooked config, key map paths and the user config folder.
- [Backend contract](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/backend-contract.html): The Dauntless backend API recovered from the client: steelyard.ca hosts (not PlayFab), the response envelope, login, characters, inventory and matchmaking.
- [Reading the JSON contract from the binary](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/json-reversing.html): How we recovered the JSON response shapes of Dauntless from the shipped 2.1.1 binary with no symbols: handlers, Serialize functions, envelopes and mistakes.
- [Client internals](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/client-internals.html): What the shipped Dauntless client can and cannot do on its own: a client-only build, launch and login switches, logging, the hang detector and ini overrides.
- [How multiplayer works](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/multiplayer.html): How Undaunted runs multiplayer on the client-only Dauntless 1.4.4 build: an injected DLL turns extra client copies into game servers for Ramsgate and hunts.
- [Crash forensics](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/crashes.html): Crash forensics for a Dauntless client with no symbols or log file: turning crash reports into instruction addresses, and what each crash turned out to be.
- [The 2.1.1 standalone attempt](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/awakening-2-1-1.html): Our first attempt on the final Dauntless 2.1.1 client: a full login chain against our own backend, Ramsgate rendered, and why no controllable player appeared.
- [Friends, parties and guilds](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/social.html): How the Dauntless 1.4.4 client does friends, parties, guilds and Slayer Links against its backend, read from the executable and the live server: the identity chain, the exact replies, why the first two-player test showed nothing, and what is still unconfirmed.
- [Text chat](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/chat.html): How the Dauntless 1.4.4 client does text chat against our server, read from the executable: why the first chat server showed UID-... instead of names, the room nickname and how we check it, which rooms exist and who may join them, and what is still unconfirmed.
- [The in-game store](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/store.html): How the Dauntless 1.4.4 client's store buys an item, read from the executable, and the free store we built from Harmonic's fork: the four routes and the purchase token, the catalogue and its tabs, stacked and instanced grants, which character gets the item, and the switches.
- [Escalation](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/escalation.html): How Dauntless 1.4.4 saves Escalation progress, and the real Escalation saves we built from Harmonic's fork: the season registry read from the client, the rules every save must pass and the ones that only warn, the old stub, and what players see when it is switched on.
- [The Harmonic port](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/findings/harmonic-fork.html): What we took from Harmonic's Dauntless 1.4.4 fork of Undaunted and what we kept of our own, feature by feature, with the reason for every choice: Escalation, the free store, Slayer Links, the deploy-server fixes, the tests, and what we left out.

## Project

- [Roadmap](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/roadmap.html): The Dauntless Revived roadmap: what already works, and milestones M0 to M4, from a safety net and playing together to saved progression and the full game loop.
- [Tools](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/tools.html): Three small Python scripts behind our Dauntless analysis: xref.py for PE string cross-references, utocdir.py for IoStore, pak9.py for pak v9, plus libooz.
- [Credits and license](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/legal.html): Credits for Undaunted by gwog and contributors, what the AGPL-3.0 asks of anyone who hosts a modified server, and why no Dauntless game files are shared here.
- [Source code on GitHub](https://github.com/mixutin/dauntless-revived): The fork's complete source, AGPL-3.0-only, on branch dauntless-revived.
- [ROADMAP.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mixutin/dauntless-revived/dauntless-revived/ROADMAP.md): The live checklist behind the roadmap page, as raw Markdown. Done items start with "- [x] **<id>", open ones with "- [ ] **<id>".

## Suomeksi (the Finnish version of the site, in plain language)

- [Dauntless Revived suomeksi](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/): Dauntless Revived on yksityinen palvelin, jolla Dauntlessia voi taas pelata: aito 1.4.4-versio ja muokattu Undaunted. Mikä toimii ja miten sen saa käyttöön.
- [Asennus](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/): Dauntless Revived Windowsissa, Linuxissa tai OpenBSD:ssa: palvelimen pystytys, kavereiden liittyminen, ryhmäkäyttö ja vianetsintä.
- [Pystytä palvelin](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/host.html): Vaiheittainen ohje Dauntless 1.4.4 -yksityispalvelimen pystyttämiseen Windows-koneelle: version tarkistus, kaksi DLL-tiedostoa, metagame ja deploy-palvelin.
- [Hosting-kumppani](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/hosting-partner.html): EU Gamehost -kumppanuus ja Dauntless Revivedille suositellut hosting-esimerkit.
- [Liity kaverina](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/friends.html): Näin kutsuttu kaveri liittyy Dauntless Revived -palvelimelle: Tailscale, tarkistettu Dauntless 1.4.4, kaksi DLL-tiedostoa, kutsukoodi ja kaveripaketti.
- [Linux-käynnistin](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/linux.html): Dauntless Revived Linuxissa: Ubuntu, Debian, Mint, Pop!_OS, Fedora, openSUSE, Arch, EndeavourOS, CachyOS, Manjaro, NixOS, Gentoo, Void ja muut x86_64-jakelut.
- [Palvelin ryhmälle](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/admin.html): Dauntless Revived -palvelin kavereille: Tailscale-jako, palomuurisäännöt, kutsukoodit, ylläpitäjän tilit, kapasiteetti ja tietokannan varmuuskopiot.
- [Steam Deck](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/steam-deck.html): Dauntless Revived Steam Deckillä: natiivi Linux-käynnistin, 800p-grafiikka-asetus ja Protonin välivideoiden vianetsintä.
- [Vianetsintä](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/troubleshooting.html): Dauntless 1.4.4 ja Dauntless Revived -palvelin: ongelmat, joihin törmäsimme, syineen ja korjauksineen. Varatut portit, kirjautuminen, sumea grafiikka, Defender ja git.
- [Windows-palvelin](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/windows-server.html): Dauntless Revived -palvelin vuokratulle Windows Server 2019 -koneelle julkisessa tilassa: yksi salattu portti, kiinnitetty varmenne, peliportit auki vain kirjautuneille, asennus SSH:lla, kutsut ja varmuuskopiot.
- [Linux-palvelin](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/linux-server.html): Dauntless Revived -palvelin x86_64-Linuxissa: natiivit Node-palvelut, Proton/Wine-pelipalvelimet, systemd ja nftables.
- [OpenBSD-palvelin](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/openbsd-server.html): Dauntless Revivedin natiivi OpenBSD 7.9 -ohjauspuoli PF:llä ja rc.d:llä sekä erillinen Linux/Proton/Wine-pelityöntekijä.
- [Päivitysohjeet](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/setup/upgrading.html): Mitä pelaajille muuttuu, kun päivität jo käytössä olevan Dauntless Revived -palvelimen: Harmonicin forkin siirto (Slayer Links päällä; Escalation, kauppa ja paikalla olo rakennettu mutta pois päältä), tekstichat, kaverit, ryhmät ja killat sekä oletuksena päällä oleva oikea eteneminen. Näin pidät vanhat maksimitasot, aloitat alusta tai jatkat tyngällä.
- [Tekninen viite](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/reference/): Dauntless Revivedin tekninen viite: jokainen asetus, portti, HTTP-reitti, tiedosto, pelin asetus ja skripti oletusarvoineen, tarkistettuna koodia vasten.
- [Asetukset](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/reference/configuration.html): Dauntless Revived -palvelinten kaikki ympäristömuuttujat: oletukset, sallitut arvot, mitä kukin tekee, kuka sen asettaa ja mitkä kytkimet ovat oletuksena päällä.
- [Portit ja verkko](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/reference/ports.html): Dauntless Revived -palvelimen kaikki TCP- ja UDP-portit: kuka kuuntelee missäkin, kuunteluosoitteet yksityisessä ja julkisessa tilassa, pyyntöjen reitit ja palvelinpaketin palomuurisäännöt.
- [HTTP-rajapinta](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/reference/api.html): Dauntless Revivedin metagamen, deploy-palvelimen, sisältöpalvelimen ja yhdyskäytävän jokainen HTTP-reitti: kuka saa kutsua sitä ja mihin internetistä pääsee.
- [Tiedostot ja data](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/reference/files.html): Missä Dauntless Revived pitää tiedostonsa: repositorio, käsin pystytetyn palvelinkoneen kansiot, palvelinpaketin asennuskansio, SQLite-tietokanta, lokit, varmuuskopiot ja käynnistin.
- [Pelin asetukset](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/reference/game-settings.html): Mitä Dauntless Revived muuttaa 1.4.4-peliohjelmassa ja pelipalvelimissa: ini-tiedostot ja kuka ne kirjoittaa, komentorivit, kaksi DLL-tiedostoa, kiinnitetty versio ja metagamen tarjoama pelidata.
- [Skriptit ja parametrit](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/reference/scripts.html): Kaikki Dauntless Revivedin ajettavat skriptit: Windows-palvelinpaketti, kaveripaketti, tools/ ja npm-skriptit, jokainen parametri oletusarvoineen ja esimerkkeineen.
- [Kehittäjän opas](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/reference/development.html): Dauntless Revivedin kehittäminen: esivaatimukset, pakettien käännös ja testit, palvelinten ja käynnistimen ajo omalla koneella, CI ja koodin sijainti.
- [Löydökset](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/): Mitä Dauntlessin verkkopuolesta on saatu selville kahdesta peliversiosta: tiedostojen tarkistus, asetukset, taustapalvelun rajapinta, moninpeli ja kaatumiset.
- [Pelitiedostojen tarkistaminen](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/verification.html): Miten varmistimme, että yhteisön arkistoimat Dauntless-versiot 2.1.1 ja 1.4.4 ovat aitoja, ehjiä ja puhtaita: allekirjoitukset, manifestit ja virustarkistus.
- [Pelin sisältö ja asetukset](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/assets.html): Miten Dauntlessin versiot 2.1.1 ja 1.4.4 tallentavat sisältönsä ja asetuksensa, miten niitä luetaan ja mitä käyttäjän asetustiedostolla voi muuttaa.
- [Taustapalvelun rajapinta](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/backend-contract.html): Dauntlessin taustapalvelut steelyard.ca-palvelimilla (ei PlayFab): palvelinnimet, kuorisäännöt ja vastausten muodot, selvitetty pelin omasta koodista.
- [JSON-rakenteen lukeminen ohjelmatiedostosta](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/json-reversing.html): Miten Dauntless 2.1.1:n koodista selvitettiin palvelinvastausten kenttien nimet, JSON-tyypit ja kuoret, sekä matkan varrella tehdyt virheet ja opetukset.
- [Asiakasohjelman sisäosat](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/client-internals.html): Mitä Dauntlessin peliohjelma osaa yksinään ja mitä ei: käynnistysvalitsimet, kirjautuminen, lokit, telemetria ja jumiutumisen tunnistin (2.1.1 ja 1.4.4).
- [Näin moninpeli toimii](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/multiplayer.html): Miten Undaunted tekee Dauntless 1.4.4 -peliohjelman kopioista pelipalvelimia DLL-tiedoston avulla, ja miksi luulimme kerran moninpelin olevan mahdoton.
- [Kaatumisten tutkiminen](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/crashes.html): Miten Dauntlessin kaatumisraportit muutetaan konekielen osoitteiksi, ja mistä kukin kohtaamamme kaatuminen johtui. Suurin osa koskee versiota 2.1.1.
- [Itsenäinen käynnistys 2.1.1:llä](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/awakening-2-1-1.html): Kokeilu käynnistää Dauntless 2.1.1 suoraan Ramsgateen ilman pelipalvelinta: mikä toimi, mihin jäimme (tyhjä tilitunnus) ja mistä työtä voi jatkaa.
- [Kaverit, ryhmät ja killat](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/social.html): Miten Dauntless 1.4.4 hoitaa kaverit, ryhmät, killat ja Slayer Linksin taustapalvelun kanssa, luettuna ohjelmatiedostosta ja oikealta palvelimelta: tunnusketju, tarkat vastaukset, miksi ensimmäisessä kahden pelaajan testissä ei näkynyt mitään ja mikä on vielä vahvistamatta.
- [Tekstichat](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/chat.html): Miten Dauntless 1.4.4 käyttää tekstichattia palvelimemme kanssa, luettuna ohjelmatiedostosta: miksi ensimmäinen chat-palvelin näytti nimien sijaan UID-...-tunnuksia, huoneiden nimimerkki ja miten tarkistamme sen, mitkä huoneet on olemassa ja kuka niihin pääsee sekä mikä on vielä vahvistamatta.
- [Pelin kauppa](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/store.html): Miten Dauntless 1.4.4 -peliohjelman kauppa ostaa tavaran, luettuna ohjelmatiedostosta, ja Harmonicin forkin pohjalta rakennettu ilmainen kauppamme: neljä reittiä ja ostotunniste, valikoima ja sen välilehdet, pinottavat ja yksilölliset tavarat, kuka hahmo ostoksen saa ja asetukset.
- [Escalation](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/escalation.html): Miten Dauntless 1.4.4 tallentaa Escalation-etenemisen ja Harmonicin forkin pohjalta rakennetut oikeat Escalation-tallennukset: peliohjelmasta luettu kausiluettelo, säännöt, jotka jokaisen tallennuksen on läpäistävä, ja ne, jotka vain varoittavat, vanha tynkä sekä se, mitä pelaajat näkevät, kun ominaisuus otetaan käyttöön.
- [Harmonicin työn siirto](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/findings/harmonic-fork.html): Mitä otimme Harmonicin Dauntless 1.4.4 -forkista ja missä pidimme oman ratkaisumme, ominaisuus kerrallaan ja jokaisen valinnan syyn kanssa: Escalation, ilmainen kauppa, Slayer Links, deploy-palvelimen korjaukset, testit ja se, mitä jätimme pois.
- [Tiekartta](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/roadmap.html): Dauntless Revivedin tiekartta selkokielellä: tavoite, välitavoitteet M0–M4, mitä on jo tehty ja mitä on työn alla. Päivittyvä lista on englanniksi.
- [Usein kysyttyä](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/faq.html): Voiko Dauntlessia vielä pelata? Onko sille yksityistä palvelinta? Lyhyet vastaukset Dauntless Revivedistä: versio, Epic-tili, liittyminen ja oma palvelin.
- [Työkalut](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/tools.html): Kolme pientä Python-työkalua Dauntlessin tutkimiseen: xref.py ohjelmatiedoston merkkijonoille, utocdir.py IoStore-säiliöille ja pak9.py pak-tiedostoille.
- [Kiitokset ja lisenssi](https://mixutin.github.io/dauntless-revived/fi/legal.html): Keiden työn varaan Dauntless Revived on rakennettu (ennen kaikkea Undaunted), mitä AGPL-3.0 käytännössä vaatii ja miksi sivustolla ei ole pelitiedostoja.
